ai_summary_zh: 本工程巡檢針對台大宿舍週邊區域（NTU_Dorm_260915）進行3D光學雷達與影像量測分析，場區內包含良好鋪設之瀝青道路與建物牆面。經地面影像核對，剔除非樹木之虛警目標（如路燈桿、店家玻璃窗及建物牆面），且場區無水域分布。
ai_summary_en: This engineering inspection analyzed the 3D photogrammetry and LiDAR dataset for the NTU Dorm area (NTU_Dorm_260915), featuring well-maintained paved asphalt roadways and building structures. Ground-level verification successfully identified and excluded non-tree false positive tags (such as lamp posts, restaurant windows, and building walls), confirming that there are no water bodies on site.
